origin: Original deliberately authored anatomical pose keys and IK control curves. No imported animation or motion capture. No samples of existing procedural pose functions.
rotationInterpolation: Monotone cubic Euler handles between intentional poses, exported as dense native quaternion keys; exact authored key poses and closed-cycle seam are retained.
runtimeContactBoundary: World-space support and ball/hand contact IK is applied after these authored body poses. The director owns event timing; exported markers do not schedule events.
